function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – What to Look For When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a quick guide to the most popular styles, what they’re good for, and tips on choosing the right one for you. | Style | Key Features | Ideal For | Pros | Cons | |-------|--------------|-----------|------|------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑leg, snug fit; elastic waistband | Everyday wear, sports, travel | • Good support
• Keeps everything in place
• Versatile | • Can feel tight if too small
• May show through tight shirts | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short leg, snug fit; elastic waistband | Work, casual, gym | • Excellent support
• Minimal bulk | • Limited coverage
• Can feel restrictive | | **Boxers** | Loose fit, short leg; elastic waistband | Sleep, lounging | • Breathable
• Comfortable | • Little support
• Can bunch up | | **Trunks** | Short leg, snug fit; elastic waistband | Fashion, gym | • Modern look
• Good support | • Less coverage than briefs | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive pouch, minimal fabric | Sports, high‑impact activities | • Excellent support
• Minimal bulk | • Not suitable for everyday wear | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight fit, elastic waistband | Recovery, high‑intensity training | • Muscle support
• Reduced friction | • Can feel restrictive if too tight | | **Performance/Tech Fabric** | Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor | Athletes, hot climates | • Keeps dry
• Odor control | • Usually pricier | | **Luxury/Designer** | Premium fabrics (silk, cashmere, high‑quality cotton) | Special occasions, gifting | • Softest feel
• Stylish | • Expensive
• Requires more care | --- ## How to Pick the Right One 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low activity**: Boxers or briefs for comfort. - **High activity**: Compression briefs or performance fabrics. 2. **Think About Fit** - **Tightness**: Too tight can restrict circulation; too loose can cause bunching. - **Waistband**: Elastic with a smooth seam is best; avoid metal or hard seams that dig in. 3. **Fabric Matters** - **Cotton**: Breathable, but can absorb sweat. - **Polyester/Spandex blends**: Moisture‑wicking, stretch. - **Bamboo, modal, Tencel**: Soft, eco‑friendly, good for sensitive skin. - **Silk, cashmere**: Luxurious, but need careful washing. 4. **Size & Shape** - Use a reliable sizing chart; many brands now offer “true‑size” or “universal” fits. - Try on a few styles if possible; online returns policies help. 5. **Durability & Care** - Look for reinforced stitching at stress points. - Follow care instructions—most performance fabrics need cold wash and no dryer. 6. **Budget** - Basic cotton briefs can be $5–$10 each. - Performance or luxury lines range from $15–$50+. --- ## Quick Style Guide | Situation | Recommended Style | Why | |-----------|-------------------|-----| | **Daily office wear** | Boxer briefs or briefs | Keeps you comfortable and looks neat under slacks. | | **Gym / running** | Compression briefs or performance briefs | Supports muscles and wicks sweat. | | **Travel** | Boxer briefs or trunks | Combines support with less bulk for packing. | | **Sleep** | Loose boxers or briefs | Breathable and relaxed. | | **Special occasion** | Luxury briefs or silk boxer briefs | Adds a touch of elegance. | --- ## Top Brands (as of 2026) | Brand | Specialty | Price Range | |-------|-----------|-------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Classic briefs & boxer briefs | $20–$40 | | **Uniqlo** | Affordable, breathable fabrics | $10–$25 | | **Under Armour** | Performance tech | $15–$35 | | **Tommy John** | Comfort‑centric, innovative cuts | $30–$60 | | **Saxx** | Ergonomic pouch, compression | $25–$45 | | **Lululemon** | High‑performance, stylish | $30–$55 | | **Bamboo Body** | Eco‑friendly bamboo | $20–$35 | | **Eberjey** | Luxury, soft fabrics | $35–$70 | --- ### Final Tips - **Rotate**: Having 3–4 pairs lets you keep each pair dry and fresh. - **Check the return policy**: If you’re buying online, make sure you can return or exchange if the fit isn’t right. - **Mind the season**: Light fabrics for summer, thicker or thermal options for winter. Happy underwear hunting! If you have a specific use case or need help narrowing down a brand, let me know.
